message.content: Jane Kim (D), the guide's selected candidate for California's statewide Insurance Commissioner seat, holds a CAIR Action endorsement and a Vote for Peace general-election support rating of Ally, and is also endorsed by AROC Action and Ro Khanna. Vote for Peace reports Kim pledged to reject war-lobby support and favors divesting public funds from war crimes and genocide. Independent spending supporting Kim includes $586,976.50 from California Working Families Party and $157,327.07 from the United Domestic Workers PAC. The other Democrat, Ben Allen, is rated Opposed by Vote for Peace in the general phase. Allen publicly supported the state party Resolutions Committee's 2019 deletion of anti-Israel language (settler colonialism, right of return, Golan Heights) from party resolutions, framed the Gaza conflict around October 7 and antisemitism after visiting Kibbutz K'far Aza, opposes BDS citing a coauthored Bloom bill, and recorded an Aye on AB 715, which creates an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight. Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club endorsed Allen in the primary. Independent spending opposing Kim includes $1,508,481.12 from JOBS PAC, sponsored by the California Chamber of Commerce.
